data.name: Aflatoon
data.gender_notes: Aflatoon is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aflatoon means 'Loyal and devoted servant' in Arabic, emphasizing the importance of loyalty and dedication in Islamic tradition. The name Aflatoon carries the meaning “Loyal and devoted servant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aflatoon usually hope their child will grow to embody loyal and devoted servant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aflatoon is a name that embodies the concept of servitude to Allah, encouraging individuals to be loyal and devoted to their faith.
data.etymology: Aflatoon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Loyal and devoted servant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aflatoon total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
